waiting: Invited on {{date}}. The club accepts the invitation in its settings.
noContacts: The club hasn't filled any functions yet.
contactsHidden: The club doesn't share its contacts.
intro: Here you see your member clubs with their number of active members and, when a club shares them, the contacts of its functions. Events you “Share with member clubs” show up in the clubs' events.
inviteHint: The club's address in Hubra, e.g. “rc-uri” from hubra.club/rc-uri. The club sees the invitation under Settings › Club and decides itself.
removeBody: {{name}} is then no longer a member club and no longer sees your shared events.
